conflicts_resolved: Title: planner_couple, sceptic and search_visitor call 'You Did Not Know?' clickbait. The title was set by the person and is not changeable, so it is not a fix item; raised as an open question only.

Key takeaways Smartraveller bullet: search_visitor wants it swapped for a tradition; funding_parent gained trust from it. The brief's reader explicitly includes Smartraveller safety and choosing Riga, Vilnius or Tallinn, and the primary persona wants more practical content, so it stays (shortened, consider).
Planner_couple wants the Advisor to 'gather and chase documents'. Ground rule: never imply help with legal or church paperwork, so the must_fix reframes the support using brand-facts.md only.
Planner_couple asks where 80-guest weddings happen and which season suits; no sourced facts exist, so the guest-logistics fix stays as general questions rather than invented insider detail.
UHNW asks for exclusive use, security and privacy claims; single persona and unconfirmed business details, so deferred rather than written in.
